about: The discovery coverage ledger. A cell is one theme in one place. Each Monday run takes the cells that scripts/research-plan.mjs lists as due, searches them as the search playbook says, and writes back the date, run id and outcome. Queries themselves live in the run's entry in research/maintenance-review-log.json; this file only says when each cell was last covered. A cell that has never been searched is absent.
